name: TOB AI Content
description: Generalized AI-generated content cache, keyed by (task, subject, variant, language, prompt_version). Covers any 'generate text about X' feature (character profiles, place overviews, event summaries, devotionals, prayers, sermon outlines, doctrine explanations, discovery facts, etc.) without a bespoke doctype per feature — TOB Bible Explanation stays separate since it's specifically reference+explanation_type scoped and already deployed/in use.

fields.label: Task
fields.description: Task key, e.g. 'character_profile', 'place_overview', 'daily_devotional' — matches a TOB AI Prompt.task.

fields.label: Subject
fields.description: Free-text subject of the task — a person's name, a place, a topic, a book, etc. Never a foreign key into a server-side entity table.

fields.label: Variant
fields.description: Optional sub-style within the task, e.g. explanation depth or audience. Blank means the task's default.
